lang_en: Hebrew numerals, Judaeo-Arabic, Western Arabic Numerals
lang_he: ספרות עבריות, יהודית-ערבית, ספרות ערביות מערביות
description:
Accounting in Judaeo-Arabic, Hebrew numerals, and western Arabic numerals. Dating: Ottoman-era. Mentioning many ships; the name of each shipowner is written over the elongated bet at the end of the word markab, e.g., Aḥmad Ṭanānī(?); Fawwāz b. Aḥmad.

Belongs with ENA NS 13.17 (PGPID 9907).
